details: bin/check calls timeout, which macOS does not have, so the first check fails as if a test failed and a round of the 3-round budget is spent; with a local shim there is no hang bound at all.
failing_case: Trial: in a fresh project made by relay setup, bin/check printed 'timeout: command not found' and exited 1 on the first run; the trial had to patch in a shim that removes the hang bound.
pass_cases: On a machine with no timeout or gtimeout, bin/check on a green project prints passed (exit 0) and on a hanging step prints HUNG within CHECK_TIMEOUT.
reason: tests/test_bin_check_portable.py test_green_step_passes_without_timeout and test_hanging_step_is_hung_within_bound: PATH without timeout/gtimeout, green gives passed exit 0, hang gives HUNG exceeded 1s exit 1. Both fail at the base commit.
findings.summary: First check in a new project on a Mac fails: no timeout
